summary: This change renames the halo-extension skill's `routines.md` reference to `automations.md`. It also rewrites the guidance to use only `halo automation` and `tools.automations`, because the `halo routine` CLI has been removed. I checked the docs against the code: the CLI subcommands in `packages/halo-cli/src/automation.ts`, the `automationInputSchema` fields, the script cwd defaults and 15-minute timeout in `AutomationRunner.ts`, and how the skill directory is copied when a workspace is seeded. Nothing still links to `routines.md`, and no executable lines changed. It is ready.
